podcast.body: This song was one of the top songs heard on AM radio in 1974, and in the context of global turmoil, it seemed "horribly, horribly irrelevant" to many. "The top songs in 1974 were the way we were from Barbara Streisand."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 1974, taken from the film of the same name starring Streisand and Robert Redford. Written by Alan and Marilyn Bergman and Marvin Hamlisch, it won the Best Original Song Oscar in 1974 and topped the Hot 100 for three weeks. Despite potential preferences for Streisand's later disco-era collaborations, "The Way We Were" is considered definitive. "If Barbara Streisand was going to score a year end number one, of course it would be a song from a movie she'd starred in."
